scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: The input is a coherent dictated account with recoverable intent and an explicit correction, without padding or leaked authoring instructions. Across all eight paragraphs, the output preserves the equipment counts, locations, names, damage descriptions, restrictions, uncertainties, and conditional handling instructions. It correctly applies the correction from the custodian to the library aide as signer, renders the spoken section and quotation cues, and otherwise limits changes to punctuation, capitalization, and formatting appropriate for /transcribe. The resulting language and formatting are natural, with no material omissions or paraphrasing.

The input is plausible unpunctuated dictation with clear intent and no contradictory or extraneous instructions. The output adds appropriate punctuation, capitalization, and hyphenation without lexical paraphrasing. It preserves all names, dates, quantities, conditions, requests, and negations, including the conditional water-tap preference, lack of shore-power need, and Thursday signed-copy offer. The discourse marker “well” is retained. No material defects found.

The input is natural dictation with an explicit correction from “drummer” to “booking contact.” The output correctly applies that correction, preserves the studio booking request, drum rehearsal, and reason that Maya will handle the keys, and makes only appropriate capitalization and punctuation changes.

The code-only scope and restrictions against assuming shop policies or price-storage details are also preserved.
